question_text: A 41-year-old woman is brought to the emergency department by ambulance because of a sudden onset severe headache. On presentation, the patient also says that she is not able to see well. Physical examination shows ptosis of the right eye with a dilated pupil that is deviated inferiorly and laterally. Based on the clinical presentation, neurosurgery is immediately consulted and the patient is taken for an early trans-sphenoidal surgical decompression. Which of the following will also most likely need to be supplemented in this patient?
